notes: Updater test hooks: TEMP_CODE_UPDATE_FEED points an isolated packaged copy (one with TEMP_CODE_USER_DATA) at a generic feed, and a `tempcodeHarness` block in the bundled package.json carries the three TEMP_CODE_* overrides into an app that Squirrel's ShipIt relaunches without our environment. update.ts writes `<userData>/app-update.yml` (provider generic, the feed URL, updaterCacheDirName temp-code-harness-updater) and sets autoUpdater.updateConfigPath to it, because electron-updater reads both the provider and its cache directory name from that one file: setFeedURL alone would still download into the installed app's `~/Library/Caches/temp-code-updater`. The override is refused without an isolated userData, so the real instance can never be pointed at another feed. harness.ts (bakedHarness/pickHarness/applyHarness, tests) fills process.env from the block before index.ts applies userData and the debug port; a build without the block has nothing to apply. CLAUDE.md's testing section documents the hooks and the coming `bun run script:e2e-updater`. Verified: typecheck, full vitest (2359), build.
